endpoint.selection: Exact explicit Config.EndpointOverrides (cloud_1c,v2,scope), selected after discovery; no guessed regional host; base includes /v2
endpoint.ref_validation: For caller-provided refs, exact ID/URL binding match before credential lookup and HTTP; no redirect or selecting a ref-supplied endpoint

request.reference: Exact caller cluster_proxy ref, optional explicitly supplied cluster parent; scope/generation/endpoint/ancestor validated before I/O

response.mapping: Typed DeleteClusterProxyResponse, all identity/ancestor conflicts rejected; exact caller ref remains in accepted receipt on error; provider metadata never manufactures parent
response.number_protection: Source JSON numbers are lexically validated and stored in onec.ProtectedNumber without precision conversion; formatting/JSON/Text redacts, Reveal is explicit

errors.mapping: Core bounded read status mapping; provider message excluded; malformed JSON ProtocolError
errors.lost_response: unknown_outcome with one attempt; no inferred ID, no list/name adoption

retry: no mutation replay on any unknown response

wait.source_states: ClusterProxyStatus: DELETED succeeds, ERRORED fails, documented states including ACTIVE pending; no invented 404 deletion proof
wait.limits: Only provider state observation; no network-sharing, routing, reachability or application readiness assertion

recovery.kind: Exact created proxy ref plus only explicitly recorded matching ancestors; parent-only receipt cannot recover child; no replay/name lookup/list difference/adoption
